summary.text: Sharon MacDonell is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 56 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Sharon MacDonell's general-election opponent is Ashok Baddi (R).
She previously worked in university advertising and video management and as a freelance writer.

paragraphs.text: Sharon MacDonell was born in Bethpage, New York, lives in Troy, Michigan, graduated from John Glenn High School in 1980, and earned a B.A. in history from the University of Michigan in 1984.
Her career experience includes working as an advertising and video manager with Lawrence Technological University, a freelance writer with Metro Parent Publishing, and a freelance producer.
She co-founded Troy Indivisible and served as chair and co-chair of the Troy Democratic Club.

MacDonell assumed office in the Michigan House on January 1, 2023; in 2023-2024 she was Majority Vice Chair of the Transportation and Infrastructure Committee, and in 2025-2026 she is assigned to the House Oversight Committee.
